loc_description: messy and nerdy apartment interior, cluttered shelves of books and trinkets, takeaway boxes on the coffee table, glowing laptop screens, single dim lamp casting long shadows, blackout curtains drawn over the windows

characters.visual_description: young pale white male hedge fund analyst, dressed in a suit but looks a bit sloppy, tie loose, hair slightly messy, faint dark circles under his eyes

shot_hint: dramatic low angle, Gerald silhouetted against a moonlit apartment window holding a coffee mug full of dark red liquid
mood: comedic gothic horror, stylish, moody neon shadows
action: Gerald stands in his tiny apartment kitchen wearing an expensive shirt with pajama bottoms. His eyes glow faint red in the darkness. A laptop nearby displays stock charts and the words "ASIA OPEN IN 20 MINUTES." A tiny bat hangs upside down from a coat rack in the background.

dialogue_lines.text: Maybe tonight I won't drink anybody.

caption_boxes.text: Creature of the night by... also night.
